source.chapter_title: Results of the Antardasas in the Mahadasa of Mercury

notes: Each antardasha is judged from the sub-period lord's dignity and house, and its position counted from the mahadasha lord. Warnings attached to lordship of the 2nd/7th (maraka), named diseases, deaths and the remedial rituals that close each section are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy.

rules.text: Mercury-Ketu: Ketu in an angle or trine with benefic influence, or in an angle or the 11th from Mercury — physical comfort, abundant earnings, affection from siblings and friends, money made through travel, educational attainment, a better reputation and an honourable meeting with authority; the comforts come at the start and middle.

Mercury-Ketu: Ketu with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury — risk of a fall from a vehicle, disputes with children, trouble from theft or authority, a pull towards poor conduct and poor company, disputes, grief and sorrow.
Mercury-Venus: with Venus in an angle, trine or the 11th — religious study, good works, ambitions achieved with the help of employer and friends, land and comfort.

variants.text: Venus is also in an angle, trine or the 11th from Mercury: wealth and property come quickly through official favour, public works are built, and prosperity grows through great success in business.

rules.text: Mercury-Venus: a weak Venus in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury — damage to reputation, grief caused by one's own people, and physical and mental strain; health needs care.
Mercury-Sun: with the Sun exalted or in its own sign, or in a trine, the 2nd or the 11th — the goodwill of authority, a rise in fortune and support from employer and friends.

variants.text: The Sun is aspected by Mars: gain of land or property at the start.
The Sun is aspected by the ascendant lord: ample happiness, wealth, a large estate and comfort of food and clothing.

rules.text: Mercury-Sun: the Sun in the 8th or 12th with Saturn, Mars or Rahu, or weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury — risk of theft, fire or injury, mental distress and worry over friends; health needs care.

Mercury-Moon: with the Moon in an angle or trine, exalted or in its own sign, or joined or aspected by Jupiter — marriage, children, clothes, a vehicle and ornaments; also a new house, fine food, music, study of the scriptures, a journey south, and goods and gems from overseas.

variants.text: The Moon in an angle, trine, 3rd or 11th: at the start, visits to holy places, contentment, a glad heart and money from abroad.

rules.text: Mercury-Moon: the Moon in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury or with a malefic — risk of theft or fire, fear of authority, strain on the marriage and on reputation, loss of money and damage to crops and livestock.

Mercury-Mars: with Mars in an angle or trine, exalted or in its own sign, or with the ascendant lord — peace and welfare at home through official favour, recovery of lost position and wealth, celebration of a child's birth, livestock, house and land, vehicles, and the goodwill of authority and spouse.

variants.text: Mars in an angle, trine or the 11th aspected by benefics: money, physical comfort, the birth of a child, a wider reputation and the affection of siblings.

rules.text: Mercury-Mars: Mars debilitated, or in the 6th or 8th under malefic influence — physical and mental strain, loss of work and of money locally, and risk of injury.

variants.text: Mars with malefics in the 8th or 12th from Mercury: distress and apprehension among siblings, trouble from authority, fire or theft, confrontation with children and friends, and loss of position; some gains come at the start.

rules.text: Mercury-Rahu: with Rahu in an angle, trine or the 11th, or in Taurus, Cancer, Virgo or Aquarius — the goodwill of authority, a highly respected position, gains of money, pilgrimage, ambitions fulfilled and respect from elders. The first half may bring some physical discomfort; the second half brings delight.

variants.text: Rahu in the 3rd, 6th, 10th or 11th with a benefic: satisfying dealings with those in power and a meeting with a new authority.

rules.text: Mercury-Rahu: with Rahu in the 8th or 12th — loss of money, with health needing care at the start.

variants.text: With malefics joining Rahu there: harshness in handling responsibilities, loss of position, great fear, restriction, distress through siblings, disrepute and loss of wealth.

rules.text: Mercury-Jupiter: with Jupiter in an angle, trine, the 2nd or the 11th, or exalted or in its own sign — physical comfort, gains of money, the employer's goodwill, a wedding, fine food, more livestock, religious study and devotion, a glad heart and growing wealth.

Mercury-Jupiter: Jupiter debilitated, combust or in the 6th, 8th or 12th, joined or aspected by Mars or Saturn — quarrels, confrontation with and penalties from authority, theft, worry over the parents, disrepute, loss of money and damage to crops.

variants.text: Jupiter is also weak in the 6th, 8th or 12th from Mercury: anxiety, physical strain, opposition from spouse and siblings, needless quarrels and lethargy.
